sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of open-weights Large Language Model (LLM) by Google DeepMind, based on Gemini research and technology. This repository contains the implementation of the gemma PyPI package.

sources.title: Gemma: Open Models Based on Gemini Research and Technology
sources.snippet: Abstract This work introduces Gemma, a family of lightweight, state-of-the art open models built from the research and technology used to create Gemini models. Gemma models demonstrate strong performance across academic benchmarks for language understanding, reasoning, and safety.
